CustomField.description: Optional. API name of a Date/DateTime field on the FORM'S target object (e.g. Account) — not on History_Target_Object_API_Name__c — whose just-submitted value should be used as the historized date instead of auto-generating today's date. Typically a sibling field in the same catalog, paired on the same form row via Same_Row_As_Previous__c. If blank, or if the referenced field wasn't part of this apply, buildDynamicHistoryRow() falls back to the previous behavior (DateTime.now()/Date.today()). Re-validated live against Schema.describe() at runtime.
CustomField.label: History Date Source Field API Name
